//: Layer 3 cells. Each is one onboarding a new user might do. reset runs on the box over its shell tool before the driver starts; precheck must print OK or the run is blocked.

reset: for s in user local project; do claude mcp remove box -s $s >/dev/null 2>&1; done; true
claude-code-landing.precheck: test -s ~/.claude/.credentials.json && ! claude mcp list 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^box' && echo OK
claude-code-landing.precheckHelp: Sign Claude Code in on the box once by hand (open a terminal on the box, run claude, finish /login). The run keeps that sign-in and removes only box's MCP entry.
claude-code-landing.handover:
You use Claude Code in a terminal on this computer. You found box by Simular and the landing page told you to paste this into your agent:

  Set up box from https://box.simular.ai/install
claude-code-landing.task: Once box is set up, ask Claude Code to use box to take a screenshot of the box and describe what is on it.
